body:
Founder real-time: 'ensure all our core repos have auto release non pre release.' New release job in build.yml, gated on push to main, correctly gated on needs:[build] -- honest caveat: won't actually fire until 'Build staging APK' succeeds, which it never has in either real CI run to date (2026-06-17/2026-07-23), most likely because the GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON repo secret was never set (human-only, same class as IDUNA's GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID gap found this session). Wired up and ready the moment that's fixed, not fixed here. MJOLNIR 7b1305f.

⚓ ☃
title: Auto-release CI wired up, matching PITVIPER's pattern (blocked on a pre-existing build gap)
